notes: conranshop.co.uk redirects to theconranshop.com (same UK entity, Shopify shop 'the-conran-shop.myshopify.com', GB/GBP) - confirmed by the prior Home-Decor pass's notes and re-verified this session; not a different company. robots.txt (fetched via Chrome) has no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow, only standard Shopify boilerplate - site is open. Reached entirely via the Claude-in-Chrome connector: navigate + get_page_text + same-origin fetch via javascript_tool for /collections.json paging (no curl/WebFetch used). Tree discovery: paged /collections.json (134 total collections) filtered to furniture-keyword handles/titles, cross-checked against the rendered mega-menu (Furniture top-nav with submenu In Stock/Chairs Stools & Benches/Tables/Storage/Bedroom Furniture/Desks/Outdoor Furniture, plus a separate 'Sofas' top-nav and a 'By Room' tab). Key finding: the site's master /collections/furniture page (216 items, rendered header) exposes a 'Product Type' filter facet that is a clean, MECE partition of the whole indoor-furniture catalogue - its 19 facet values sum EXACTLY to 216 (verified by addition), which is a strong site-wide sanity check per project rule 4. Used this facet as the deepest true leaf level in preference to the nav's overlapping marketing collections: spot-checked 'Storage' (44 items) and 'Bedroom Furniture' (55 items) and 'Sofas & Armchairs' (68 items) nav collections and confirmed by product-title inspection that every item in them is already covered by one of the Product Type facet buckets on the master Furniture page (e.g. Storage = Coat Stands + Coat Hooks + Pillar bedside/console/sideboard items, all already counted under their own product types) - recording these nav collections as additional rows would have double-counted products already captured, so they were deliberately excluded per the 'never emit duplicate rows / no parent-as-leaf plus children' rule. Outdoor Furniture (14 items) was confirmed DISJOINT from the 216-item master collection (its product types - Doric Side Table, Ten-Pin Side Table, Fold Outdoor sofas/armchairs - do not appear in the master facet list) so it is recorded as its own leaf. Excluded 3 of the 19 Product Type facet values after opening each and inspecting titles: 'Bed Slats' (2, spare/replacement bed-frame slats - a furniture part/component, not a standalone furniture item), 'Coat Hooks' (3, small wall-mounted 'Fish Hook' hooks - decor hardware, not freestanding furniture, unlike the separately-kept Coat Stands), 'Sofa Covers' (5, 'Cover Only' replacement slipcovers for the Nicholson sofa - a furniture accessory/protector, not the sofa itself). All qty values are the rendered '(N)' facet count shown next to each Product Type checkbox on the live filtered listing page (each spot-checked against its own filtered page's '<N> of 216 items' header, which matched exactly in every case checked). No mattresses, mirrors, lighting, textiles, or standalone storage boxes found under Furniture. No kids/nursery furniture found in the collections.json census or mega-menu. Sanity checks per rule 4: numbers changed per filter (not a site-wide constant), none were suspiciously round, h1/breadcrumb matched the requested node on every page opened (e.g. 'FURNITURE OUTDOOR FURNITURE' breadcrumb on the outdoor page).
